messages:
marco: Quick thought: add a \"snapshot permalink\" from the route inspector so folks can share an exact telemetry view (filters + pinned models + sampling). Useful for bug reports and postmortems.

nina: Nice. do we want ephemeral links (7d) vs published snapshots? ephemeral is low-friction.

cory: Ephemeral + publish toggle sounds right. main backend concern: cost estimate when publishing. people will accidentally run heavy queries.

anika: For estimates we should use precomputed histograms per route+model to approximate token cost instead of executing the full query. cheap and conservative.

marco: UX: show a small badge on charts when a view is sampled: \"sampled view (1%)\" and in the permalink modal show sample rate and sampled_count.

nina: API sketch: POST /api/console/snapshots {scope, route_id, filters, model_pins, sample_rate, publish}. returns {id, estimate_tokens, warnings}.

cory: Implementation note: when publish=true, resolve model_pins -> immutable model_version_ids (hash) and store those to avoid drift during rollouts. ephemeral links keep soft refs.

anika: Security: ephemeral links must be unguessable tokens and require org membership on access. also rate-limit dry-run endpoints (10/min per org).

marco: Also add quick-copy button that copies the permalink + a one-line preview for slack. e.g. \"r:payments | m:latest | filters: status=500 | sample:1%\"

nina: UI flow: (1) user clicks snapshot in inspector, (2) modal shows preview + estimate, (3) user can copy ephemeral link or publish to saved views. Default to ephemeral.

cory: Quota guardrail: if estimate_tokens > 0.8 * quota_remaining block publish and require explicit owner approval. For dedicated capacity we can auto-approve if org flag set.

anika: Telemetry: emit snapshot.created event with fields (mode, estimate_tokens, sample_rate) so we can monitor usage of dry-run estimator.

infra-bot: canary flag scheduled: console.snapshot_permalinks -> enable for analytics beta orgs on 2024-06-10T09:00:00Z.

marco: I'll write a short RFC with API shapes, UI mock, and rollout plan. tagging infra for histograms and billing for estimator. thanks everyone!
